plan.summary: FEAT-PROJELER slice S1: migration 057 adds the inert, schema-only 'Projeler' parent layer (projects table + project_targets junction + nullable bulk_send_jobs.project_id FK) above the unchanged bulk send engine, plus the canonical outbound.sql mirror. No runtime behaviour change.
plan.q_intent: Q chose PKT-2/PKT-14 (Projeler) as the next package, sliced into 4 (S1 schema, S2 CRUD, S3 cxapi template-list, S4 UI), with the 'full parent model' for the projects table and a fresh PKT number. S1 = the migration 057 schema slice.
plan.interview_notes: Decisions (AskUserQuestion 2026-06-07): (1) 4-slice split, plan S1 first; (2) full parent model mirroring TONIVA mode4 ivr_campaigns structure minus telephony — status state machine, instance_id, template config, denormalized counters, archived soft-delete, project_targets junction (1 project -> N data_lists), bulk_send_jobs.project_id FK; Run = bulk_send_job (per roadmap, bulk engine unchanged); (3) fresh packet id PKT-14 (existing PKT-2 = unrelated DONE 'Saglik Core'); add a distinct FEAT-PROJELER README row at wrap. S1 stays inert and independent of the P0-3 cxapi live-enablement gate, exactly like migrations 055/056.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 057-projeler-schema.sql creates a tenant-scoped 'projects' table (full parent model: lifecycle status, project-level cxapi config, denormalized roll-up counters, archived soft-delete) with composite UNIQUE(tenant_id,id), the normalized active-name partial-unique index, GRANT ALL to invekto, and an INV-SEED-057 fail-loud verifier.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Implemented in 057-projeler-schema.sql; verifier asserts table, composite unique, status CHECK, name index.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A 'project_targets' junction (1 project -> N data_lists) and a nullable bulk_send_jobs.project_id composite FK are added so existing/project-less runs stay valid; cross-tenant child rows are structurally impossible (composite FKs to projects(tenant_id,id) and data_lists(tenant_id,id)).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: project_targets composite FKs + bulk_send_jobs.project_id nullable composite FK (MATCH SIMPLE) implemented; verifier asserts both.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The migration is additive, idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS + named DROP/ADD), and INERT (no .cs touched, no shipped code reads the new columns; independent of the P0-3 live-enablement gate), with the canonical arch/db/outbound.sql mirrored in the same change (CQ11).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Both files updated; outbound.sql mirrors projects/project_targets + bulk_send_jobs.project_id column+FK; zero .cs changes -> build N/A.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: projects ships the 'full parent model' (lifecycle status, instance_id, template_kind/wa_template_id/template_language/param_mapping, run/sent/delivered/read/failed/ambiguous counters) even though shipped code reads none of them yet.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q chose the full model in interview; the column set is the inert parent schema that S2 CRUD + S4 UI populate. Reserving the inert columns now avoids a churn of follow-up ALTERs and mirrors the PR-1 (migration 055) 'reserved nullable columns, open now / implement later' precedent.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED inert/reserved columns — NOT dead schema. This is a deliberate schema-only slice (S1 of 4). No runtime reader is expected to exist yet; CRUD lands in S2, cxapi config use in PR-4. Do not flag as YAGNI/unused.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: bulk_send_jobs.project_id is a NULLABLE composite FK (tenant_id, project_id) -> projects(tenant_id, id) with ON DELETE RESTRICT.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Nullable + MATCH SIMPLE keeps every existing/project-less run valid (FK unchecked while project_id is NULL). Composite FK guarantees cross-tenant integrity. RESTRICT (not SET NULL/CASCADE) protects run history: projects are soft-deleted via archived_at, never hard-deleted once they have runs (TONIVA PiaBella incident: FK-cascade hard delete orphaned downstream billable records).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED RESTRICT, not SET NULL/CASCADE. SET NULL is impossible on this composite FK anyway (tenant_id is NOT NULL). The soft-delete-as-archive policy makes hard delete a refused edge case. Not a bug.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: projects carries BOTH a status value 'archived' AND an archived_at timestamp.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: archived_at is the soft-delete marker that drives the name-reuse partial-unique index (WHERE archived_at IS NULL) and records WHEN archived for reconciliation — directly mirroring the sibling data_lists.deleted_at convention. status='archived' is the lifecycle terminal value the two co-set. Same timestamp-predicate + lifecycle split data_lists already uses.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED archived_at + status='archived' coexistence — consistent with data_lists (deleted_at + status). archived_at is the index predicate + audit timestamp, status is the lifecycle enum. Not redundant duplication.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Canonical outbound.sql places the FEAT-PROJELER block AFTER data_lists and adds bulk_send_jobs.project_id as an inline column but its FK via a later ALTER.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Fresh top-to-bottom apply must resolve composite FKs: projects/project_targets reference data_lists(tenant_id,id) (defined earlier) and projects(tenant_id,id); bulk_send_jobs (defined earlier) gets its project_id FK via ALTER once projects exists. Matches the migration's apply order.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED ordering: the inline column + deferred ALTER FK is intentional to keep a fresh canonical apply valid. Mirrors migration 057 exactly. Not an inconsistency between migration and canonical.

files_changed.change: NEW migration 057: projects table (full parent model) + project_targets junction + bulk_send_jobs.project_id nullable composite FK + indexes + GRANTs + INV-SEED-057 fail-loud verifier. Additive, idempotent, inert.

Canonical mirror (CQ11): add bulk_send_jobs.project_id column inline; add FEAT-PROJELER section (projects + project_targets + bulk_send_jobs.project_id FK + indexes + GRANTs) after the data_lists block.

verification_questions.question: Do existing bulk_send_jobs rows and current project-less inserts remain valid after the nullable composite FK (tenant_id, project_id) -> projects is added, given tenant_id is NOT NULL and project_id is newly NULL?
Is cross-tenant contamination structurally impossible for project_targets and bulk_send_jobs.project_id — i.e. can a child row ever reference a project or data_list belonging to a different tenant?

Is migration 057 fully idempotent and safe to re-run, and does a fresh top-to-bottom apply of both the migration and the canonical outbound.sql resolve every composite FK in dependency order (data_lists, projects, project_targets, bulk_send_jobs ALTER)?

Is the change genuinely inert/no-op at runtime (no .cs touched, no shipped reader of the new columns) and independent of the P0-3 cxapi live-enablement gate, so it can merge without any tenant being allowlisted?

forbidden_areas: src/** (no .cs/.ts changes in S1 — schema only; CRUD is S2)
Any CxapiSend feature-flag / AllowedTenantIds config (P0-3 gate must not be touched)
bulk_send_jobs cxapi send columns (instance/template/param) — those are PR-4, not S1
outbound_messages / outbound_broadcasts (untouched; runs/sends are downstream slices)
non_goals: projects CRUD endpoints, repository, service, DTOs (S2)
Populating/recomputing the denormalized counters (wired when runs attach in S2+)
Allowlisting any tenant for live cxapi sends
intentional_exclusions: INV-OB-066+ projects error codes — reserved for S2 (no runtime errors emitted in a schema-only slice; errors.md untouched)
No data backfill — all existing bulk_send_jobs rows keep project_id = NULL by design
No FK on projects.created_by (no local users table; tenant user ids live in INMA)
No daily auto-schedule columns (TONIVA scheduler is an optional later phase, out of v1 scope)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Pure DDL slice. The INV-SEED-057 DO $verify$ block RAISES EXCEPTION (fail-loud) if any object is missing post-apply, so a partial/failed migration cannot pass silently. No application code path, no try/catch, no user-facing surface in S1.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators re-build the same audience+template blast from scratch every campaign, with no way to group related sends.
aha_moments.suggestion: The projects parent lets a tenant define a reusable 'Proje' (instance + template + target lists) once and spawn many runs under it.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the operator opens Projeler in S4 and sees their past runs grouped under one named project instead of a flat list of one-off blasts.

aha_moments.user_pain: A cross-tenant data leak in a multi-tenant blast tool is catastrophic and irreversible (wrong customers messaged).
aha_moments.suggestion: Composite (tenant_id, *_id) FKs to projects(tenant_id,id) and data_lists(tenant_id,id) make a cross-tenant child row impossible even with an app bug.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a future app-layer bug tries to attach another tenant's list to a project and Postgres refuses the row outright — the leak never happens.

aha_moments.user_pain: Deleting a finished campaign destroys the delivery history support/finance need for reconciliation (the TONIVA PiaBella incident).
aha_moments.suggestion: Soft-delete-as-archive (archived_at) + ON DELETE RESTRICT on runs means a project with history can be archived but never hard-deleted, preserving counters and run rows.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When support pulls an archived project months later and every run + counter is still intact for a billing dispute.

aha_moments.user_pain: Listing a tenant's active projects shouldn't scan archived clutter or slow down as history grows.
aha_moments.suggestion: Partial indexes (uq_projects_tenant_name_active, idx_projects_tenant_created) scoped to WHERE archived_at IS NULL keep the active-project list fast and the name reusable after archive.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the Projeler list loads instantly for a tenant with thousands of archived projects.

aha_moments.user_pain: A half-applied schema migration on production silently leaves the feature half-built and fails mysteriously later.
aha_moments.suggestion: The INV-SEED-057 fail-loud verifier asserts every table/constraint/column/index exists and RAISES EXCEPTION otherwise, so a bad apply aborts loudly at deploy time.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a deploy that didn't fully apply the migration stops immediately with a precise INV-SEED-057 message instead of surfacing as a runtime 500 days later.

aha_moments.user_pain: Prospects ask 'can I run repeatable WhatsApp campaigns to my saved lists, not just one-off blasts?' and today the answer is no.
aha_moments.suggestion: The projects layer is the schema foundation that turns Invekto's bulk engine into a repeatable, list-targeted 'Projeler' campaign product (TONIVA mode4 parity for WhatsApp).
aha_moments.aha_moment: When sales can demo a named project that re-targets a saved list with one click instead of re-uploading a CSV each time.

verdict.raw_text: Codex (mcp__codex-review__codex_review, model gpt-5.5-2026-04-23) iteration 0: OVERALL PASS. Code Quality Gate 12/12 PASS (CQ1-CQ12), CoVe 4/4 PASS (Q1-Q4), 0 blocking issues. 12482 tokens. Summary: schema-only FEAT-PROJELER S1 migration is additive, tenant-scoped, mirrored in canonical outbound.sql, no runtime behaviour change; nullable composite FK preserves existing project-less bulk_send_jobs while enforcing tenant-safe references when project_id is present. (Plan schema v5.1 stores CQ1-CQ8 below; CQ9-CQ12 all PASS per raw Codex output.)

CQ1.evidence: Fail-loud verifier with specific RAISE EXCEPTION per expected artifact; no runtime/user-facing path.

CQ2.evidence: No swallowed exceptions; verifier raises instead of silently continuing.

CQ3.evidence: Only the new migration + canonical outbound.sql changed; matches schema-only scope. No .cs/API/UI/auth.

CQ4.evidence: Migration<->canonical duplication is required project policy, not reusable-code duplication.

CQ5.evidence: snake_case throughout; tenant_id scoping, composite tenant constraints, indexes, GRANT ALL canon.

CQ6.evidence: No runtime loops/N+1; partial indexes support tenant/project lookup paths.

CQ7.evidence: No new TODO/HACK/FIXME; deferred-scope notes are explicit roadmap comments.

CQ8.evidence: project_id added nullable; MATCH SIMPLE leaves FK unchecked while NULL, so existing rows/inserts stay valid; no contract change.

Q1.reasoning: Nullable project_id + MATCH SIMPLE => FK not enforced when NULL; existing/project-less bulk_send_jobs remain valid.

Q2.reasoning: Composite FKs (tenant_id, *_id) -> projects(tenant_id,id) and data_lists(tenant_id,id) make cross-tenant child rows impossible at the DB level.

Q3.reasoning: IF NOT EXISTS + DROP/ADD CONSTRAINT idempotency; canonical places projects/project_targets after data_lists and adds the bulk_send_jobs FK via ALTER so fresh apply resolves in dependency order.

Q4.reasoning: Only the 2 SQL files change; cxapi columns marked inert until PR-4; no allowlisting/send-path touched; gate-independent.
